meanings.usage: 形容人的行为或言语不礼貌
用于反射影像的玻璃制品
形容当代的或新式的物品
海岸边指引船只的塔状建筑

phrases.usage: 表示不必如此粗鲁，用于表达对他人不礼貌行为的不满

examples.en: You needn't be so rude about it.

phrases.phrase: looked at herself in the mirror
phrases.usage: 照镜子，描述看着镜中的自己

examples.en: My wife looked at herself in the mirror.
examples.zh: 我妻子看着镜中的自己。

examples.en: We mustn't buy things we don't need.
examples.zh: 我们不应该买不需要的东西。

phrases.usage: 表示本不必说（但已经说了），带有后悔意味

examples.en: I regretted saying it almost at once. You needn't have said that.
examples.zh: 我几乎立刻就后悔说了那句话。你本不必说的。

phrases.phrase: A man can never have too many ties
phrases.usage: 男人永远不会嫌领带太多（自我安慰的话）

examples.en: A man can never have too many ties.
examples.zh: 男人永远不会嫌领带太多。

examples.en: Ten minutes later we walked out of the shop together.
examples.zh: 十分钟后我们一起走出了商店。

phrases.usage: 戴着帽子，描述穿戴状态

examples.en: My wife was wearing a hat that looked like a lighthouse!
examples.zh: 我妻子戴着一顶看起来像灯塔的帽子！

examples.en: My wife was still in front of the mirror.
I sat down on one of those modern chairs.
examples.zh: 我坐在一把现代化的椅子上。

phrases.usage: 我不需要提醒你（暗示对方应该记得）

examples.en: I needn't remind you of that terrible tie you bought yesterday.
examples.zh: 我不需要提醒你那条昨天买的糟糕领带。

grammar.title: needn't have + 过去分词
grammar.structure: 主语 + needn't have + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示本不必做某事（但实际上已经做了），含有后悔或责备的意味 用于表达做了不必要的事情，语气中带有遗憾

examples.en: I needn't have worried about you.
She needn't have bought so much food.
examples.zh: 她本不必买那么多食物的。

grammar.title: mustn't 与 needn't 的区别
grammar.definition: mustn't表示禁止（不允许），needn't表示不必要（不需要） 两者含义完全不同，mustn't表示规则或命令禁止做某事，needn't表示没有义务做某事

examples.en: We mustn't buy things we don't need.
examples.zh: 我们不可以买不需要的东西。

grammar.title: can't have too many + 名词
grammar.structure: can't have too many + 可数名词复数
grammar.definition: 永远不会嫌...太多（表示对某物的喜爱或追求） 用于表达对某类物品的喜好，强调想要更多

examples.en: A man can never have too many ties.
examples.zh: 男人永远不会嫌领带太多。

examples.en: You can't have too many friends.

text.title: Do you call that a hat?

lines.en: 'You needn't be so rude about it,' my wife answered as she looked at herself in the mirror.
lines.zh: “你说话没必要这样不客气，”我的妻子边回答边照着镜子。

lines.en: I sat down on one of those modern chairs with holes in it and waited.
lines.zh: 我坐在一个新式的满是网眼儿的椅子上，等待着。

lines.en: We had been in the hat shop for half an hour and my wife was still in front of the mirror.
lines.zh: 我们在这家帽店已经呆了半个小时了，而我的妻子仍在镜子面前。

lines.en: 'We mustn't buy things we don't need,' I remarked suddenly. I regretted saying it almost at once.
lines.zh: “我们不应该买我们不需要的东西，”我突然发表意见说，但马上又后悔说了这话。

lines.en: 'You needn't have said that,' my wife answered. 'I needn't remind you of that terrible tie you bought yesterday.
lines.zh: “你没必要这么说，”我妻子回答说，“我也不必提醒你昨天买的那条糟糕透了的领带。
”“我觉得它好看，”我说，“男人有多少领带也不会嫌多。

lines.en: 'A man can never have too many ties.
'And a woman can't have too many hats,' she answered.
Ten minutes later we walked out of the shop together.
lines.zh: 10分钟以后，我们一道走出了商店。

lines.en: My wife was wearing a hat that looked like a lighthouse!
lines.zh: 我妻子戴着一顶像灯塔一样的帽子。

questions.q: What kind of shopping does the writer enjoy, do you think?
questions.zh: 你认为作者喜欢什么样的购物？
questions.a: None. He doesn't enjoy shopping at all. He sat on a modern chair with holes in it and waited impatiently, and said they mustn't buy things they didn't need.
questions.aZh: 哪种都不喜欢。他坐在网眼儿椅子上不耐烦地干等，还说不该买不需要的东西。
questions.hint: 见课文第 2 句妻子责他 rude、第 5 句 We mustn't buy things we don't need。

questions.q: Why does the wife say 'You needn't be so rude about it' instead of 'You mustn't be so rude about it'?
questions.zh: 为什么妻子说 needn't be so rude，而不用 mustn't be so rude？
questions.a: Because needn't means 'it is not necessary' — she is only advising him that his remark was unnecessary, not forbidding him. Mustn't expresses absolute prohibition.
questions.aZh: 因为 needn't 表示“没必要”，只是劝他说话不必这样不客气；mustn't 表示绝对禁止。
questions.hint: 见语法部分：mustn't 表示绝对禁止。

questions.q: What does 'I needn't remind you of that terrible tie you bought yesterday' tell us about the structure of remind?
questions.zh: “我不必提醒你昨天买的那条糟糕透了的领带”一句体现了 remind 的什么用法？
questions.a: It shows 'remind sb. of sth.' — 提醒某人想起某事.
questions.aZh: 体现 remind sb. of sth.（提醒某人某事／使某人想起）。
questions.hint: 见词语学习 remind 条。

questions.q: Why is the past perfect continuous used in 'We had been in the hat shop for half an hour'?
questions.zh: “我们在这家帽店已经待了半小时”为什么用过去完成进行时？
questions.a: It describes an action that had been going on continuously before a later past moment — they had already waited half an hour and the wife was still in front of the mirror.
questions.aZh: 过去完成进行时表示在过去某一时刻之前持续进行的动作，突出丈夫的不耐烦。
questions.hint: 结合后半句 my wife was still in front of the mirror。

questions.q: Why does the husband say 'A man can never have too many ties', and how does the wife turn it against him?
questions.zh: 丈夫为什么说“男人有多少领带也不会嫌多”？妻子又是怎样将计就计的？
questions.a: He uses 'can never...too...' to defend the terrible tie he bought. The wife immediately turns the same structure round — 'a woman can't have too many hats' — so buying a hat becomes equally justified.
questions.aZh: 他用 can never...too... 为昨天买的领带辩护；妻子套用同一句式说女人有多少帽子也不嫌多。
questions.hint: 以及结尾 Ten minutes later... looked like a lighthouse。

translation:
“你把那个叫帽子吗？
”我对妻子说。
“你说话没必要这样不客气，”我的妻子边回答边照着镜子。
我坐在一个新式的满是网眼儿的椅子上，等待着。
我们在这家帽店已经呆了半个小时了，而我的妻子仍在镜子面前。
“我们不应该买我们不需要的东西，”我突然发表意见说，但马上又后悔说了这话。
“你没必要这么说，”我妻子回答说，“我也不必提醒你昨天买的那条糟糕透了的领带。
”“我觉得它好看，”我说，“男人有多少领带也不会嫌多。
”“女人有多少帽子也不嫌多。
”她回答。
10分钟以后，我们一道走出了商店。
我妻子戴着一顶像灯塔一样的帽子。
title: Do You Call That a Hat?
subtitle: 你把那个叫帽子吗？

lead.question: 陪妻子逛帽店时，丈夫说了哪句话，一出口就后悔了？
lead.warmup: 丈夫陪妻子逛了半小时帽店，坐在一把满是网眼儿的新式椅子上干等，妻子却仍站在镜子前试帽子。他忍不住说“不该买不需要的东西”，话一出口就后悔了——妻子立刻反唇相讥，提起他昨天买的那条糟糕透了的领带。十分钟后两人一起走出店门，妻子头上戴着一顶像灯塔一样的帽子。
goals: 分清 needn't、mustn't、don't have to 与 needn't have done 的含义和用法
体会 Do you call that a hat? 中的轻蔑、不满语气
掌握 can never...too...（再……也不为过）以及 regret doing、remind sb. of sth. 等结构
辨析 remark / notice / observe 等“说”与“察觉”类动词的用法差别
lead.summary: 本课借一对夫妻在帽店的斗嘴，集中训练“必要与不必要”的情态表达：needn't 表示不必，mustn't 表示禁止，needn't have done 表示本不必做却已经做了。同时通过 Do you call that a hat?、A man can never have too many ties 等句子，体会英语里轻蔑、不耐烦与“越多越好”的地道说法。
lead.tips: needn't have done 是“本不必做却做了”；didn't need to / didn't have to 只说明过去不必做，是否做过并不明确。

quiz.q: “我们不应该买我们不需要的东西。”正确的是哪一句？
options: We mustn't buy things we don't need.
We needn't buy things we don't need.
We mustn't to buy things we don't need.
We don't need buy things we don't need.

quiz.q: “你没必要这么说。”（暗含：其实已经说了）应选哪句？
options: You needn't say that.
You needn't have said that.
You mustn't have said that.
You didn't need say that.
quiz.note: needn't have done 指本不必做却做了。

quiz.q: “我妻子戴着一顶像灯塔一样的帽子。”正确的英文是？
options: My wife was wearing a hat that looked like a lighthouse!
My wife was wearing a hat that looked as a lighthouse!
My wife wore a hat which looked lighthouse!
My wife was wearing a hat that looked like lighthouse.

quiz.q: “男人有多少领带也不会嫌多。”正确的英文是？
options: A man can never have too much ties.
A man can have too many ties never.
A man can never have too many ties.
A man cannot have too much ties.

quiz.q: “她边照镜子边回答。”正确的英文是？
options: She answered as she looked at her in the mirror.
She answered as she looked herself in the mirror.
She answered as she was looking her in the mirror.
She answered as she looked at herself in the mirror.
quiz.note: look at oneself 反身代词不可省。

quiz.q: “你不必工作那么长时间。”正确的英文是？
options: You needn't work such long hours.
You mustn't work such long hours.
You needn't to work such long hours.
You don't need work such long hours.
quiz.note: 情态 needn't 直接加动词原形。
